scenario: WIBTA if I confronted the dean of my college for outing my mental health to my abusive mother? | My mother is a narcissistic, abusive woman who has sucked any remaining will to live out of me. She disowned me for needing to come home in my senior year of college (she chose my major and school) early due to a mental breakdown. I want to send an email asking the dean why she would do this after being so supportive and sweet to me. Does she have any legal right to do this as I am an adult? Obviously this would not help me at this point since I just graduated, but it would be cathartic. WIBTA?
